name: dual-v100-native-fp4-target50-screens-20261019
scope: Frozen native ModelOpt FP4 workload and conditional resource rooflines; no timing fit or unseen-prompt accuracy claim.

hardware.h2d_scope: Concurrent 256 MiB registered-RAM DMA probe; not sustained inference bandwidth.

specifications.scope: V100 PCIe 900 GB/s HBM and 112 TFLOP/s tensor peak; not the V100S.
Six DDR4-2933 channels per socket; installed DIMM speed and population were not measured.

hardware.peer_transport_scope: Peer access available on the measured dual-V100 node; no peer-bandwidth probe. Non-peer pinned-host fallback compiled but not exercised.
hardware.cpu_stream_scope: 4 GiB read-only AVX-512 probe, 32 pinned workers, 15 passes per sample, two warmups and five timed samples; excludes FP4 arithmetic and scale lookup.

observations.name: preserved-greedy
observations.protocol: 8192 to 512, one full warmup, three clean timed requests; 35 CPU workers.

observations.name: q8-drop-greedy
observations.protocol: 8192 to 512, one full warmup, three clean timed requests; 32 CPU workers.

protocol.prompt: Same frozen 8192 token IDs as the reference; SHA256 recorded per run.
protocol.generation: 512 token IDs, fixed length with stop IDs disabled. Decode times 511 advances after the prefill token.
protocol.warmup: Two complete requests, then a discarded prefill request; three timed requests in one process.
protocol.residency: All timed major faults and observed swap must be zero. Decoder must exit successfully.
protocol.cgroup_scope: before/after numeric memory-controller records; peaks include the whole allocation, not only the selected run.
protocol.quality_selection: Select using throughput and three training tasks, then evaluate the frozen twenty held-out tasks once. No held-out tuning.

limitations: Conditional resource roofs are optimistic workload bounds, not forecasts or fitted timing predictions.
CPU roof counts code bytes once per expert group, omitting metadata, activation traffic, integer unpack/dot throughput and scheduling; the separate read-only probe is not sustained expert bandwidth.
Installed DIMM speed is unknown and clocks were not locked. Huge pages were disabled.
Exact matrix DMA counters omit activation transfers and end their prefill phase at compact. The older discarded-request traffic proxy is retained separately for comparison.
Ideal projection FLOPs omit attention contractions, KDA, normalization, mHC, reconstruction and launches. Independent resources are optimistically overlapped.
One performance prompt and eight reused training checks do not establish general quality or throughput. New holdouts are unscored; HIP is compile-only.
